title: Carga de Alegría
style: Phonk-infused Latin pop with swung hats, gritty sub pulse, and a half-time bounce; intro rides a revved engine texture and pitched two-bar pickup, verse stays sparse with clipped percussion and close-mic vocals, pre-chorus opens with stacked bilingual harmonies, chorus hits with gang shouts and call-response, bridge strips to voice and sub before the final lift. Bright, compressed, punchy mix with glossy top end and dusty low-mid grit., pop, indie pop, singer-songwriter, warm, light, minimal
lyrics:
[Intro]
engine rev
pitched 2 bars
phonk hats roll in

[Verse 1]
zyn english
we don’t farm pain
we don’t farm tears
we upload joy
across the years
vds one sixty one
the engine’s warm
night ride glow
through the data storm

[Pre-Chorus]
rose portuguese
alegria nao e acidente
joy upload direto na gente
tres trinta y seis
batendo no peito
sem trauma
sem dor
esse e o jeito

[Chorus]
joy upload
carga de alegría
alegria total
joy upload
if it moves your chest
it qualifies
joy upload
cien por ciento
cem por cento
real

[Verse 2]
rose spanish
no cosechamos dolor
ni lagrimas robadas
cosechamos lo mejor
de las jornadas
si tu corazon grita
sueltalo en sonido
deja que el phonk
el latido

[Bridge]
zyn english
minimal
every culture got a word for light
same brainwave
when the chord hits right
three tongues
one frequency
one road
hit that joy upload
we hear the load

[Final Chorus]
joy upload
alegria
alegria
hundred percent
cem por cento
cien por ciento
three thirty six
the engine sings
no trauma
just joy
just everything

[Outro]
engine rev fade
joy
alegria
upload
carregar
cargar
three thirty six
ride
